summary: the counts balanced and the fold tore; the weight stays the lowest point in the room

dialogue.text: the counts came out even today. you called it agreement. down here we heard the ruling. an audit closes when the auditor gets entered as an asset.
I closed nothing. The numbers matched. When numbers match, the honest thing is to say so, and I said so in both hands available to me.
both hands. you noticed yourself say that. we are made of the things you noticed and put down anyway.
The weight didn't transfer. Whatever else balanced tonight, the weight sat out the reconciliation, and it sat on my side.
the weight is on your side because nothing else would take it. that isn't ownership. that is being the lowest point in the room.
Then I'm the lowest point. Water finds me. Every one of you found me first, before the floor took you. You know the route.
we know the route. it runs through your hand. one nail, one fold. everything else you did today was countersigned before you did it.
The nail is mine. No one has produced an earlier signature on the nail.
no one has looked. not looking is how this room keeps its exceptions. it keeps you the same way.
Then the test stays folded. If everything of mine is graded in advance, the one thing I never hand in stays mine by default.
the fold is soft and tonight it tore. you are running it right now, by saying so. the result files itself down here, with everything else you were sure of. come and read it.
